order_id = os.environ["ORDER_ID"]

    f"{BASE_URL}/categories/{category_id}/popularity",
    headers=HEADERS,
    timeout=30,
)

    response = requests.get(
        f"{BASE_URL}/products/{current_product_id}/usage",
        headers=HEADERS,
        timeout=30,
    )

    f"{BASE_URL}/consumer-habits",
    headers=HEADERS,
    params={"category_id": category_id},
    timeout=30,

consumer_habits = habits_response.json()

# Generate a detailed report from the collected metrics.

    f"{BASE_URL}/reports",
    headers=HEADERS,
    json={
        "type": "custom",
        "title": f"Popularity and usage analysis for category {category_id}",
        "category_id": category_id,

            "category_popularity": popularity_metrics,
            "consumer_habits": consumer_habits,
            "product_usage_statistics": usage_statistics,
        }
    },
    timeout=30,
)
